definitions.btc_volatility_30d: Sample standard deviation of preceding 30 complete BTC 24h simple returns; unannualized
definitions.relative_quote_volume: Complete preceding 24h quote volume across fixed assets / strictly previous seven complete daily totals mean
definitions.return_dispersion_24h: Sample cross-asset standard deviation of preceding 24h simple returns; full asset universe required

rule: high >= development median; low < median; missing is unknown
